$comment: Third-party artwork and icon sets shipped in ynotPDF, with source, author and licence. Operator rule, 2026-09-09: every icon set and every clipart item used goes in here, and M131 renders it as the acknowledgements page. Add a row when you add artwork; the rule is permissive licences only — CC0 preferred, CC BY acceptable, never BY-SA / NC / ND, and never Freepik, Flaticon, Vecteezy, Clker, the Noun Project, Icons8, Font Awesome or an image-search result. Code dependencies are not listed here: `npm run licenses` covers those.

iconSets.name: Lucide
iconSets.author: Lucide contributors
iconSets.note: Every icon in the interface. Drawn inline as SVG with stroke="currentColor", so contrast comes from the theme's --icon token and never from the icon itself.

fonts.name: DejaVu Fonts
fonts.author: DejaVu authors, Bitstream Inc.
fonts.note: Substitution fonts for documents whose own fonts are not embedded. M130 also offers them as the interface font, for readers who find the system face hard to read.

fonts.name: Liberation Fonts
fonts.author: Red Hat, Inc.
fonts.note: Metric-compatible substitutes for Arial, Times New Roman and Courier New. M130 also offers them as the interface font, for readers who find the system face hard to read.
